rules: Cases may be added after the first run but never removed or edited; every addition is listed on the Testing page.
All figures are constructed by the team. No real user data.
Each case's report is the input of build_facts and llm_allowed, evaluated at the case's 'now' (server time zone Asia/Seoul).
notes: buffer_shift: the summary facts (FACT_KEYS) carry no buffer field in 0.22.0, so a buffer change reaches the summary only through the week-over-week rate change and the slack. These cases model that.
not_allowed follows the 4.3 note of 2026-11-20: weeks with 0 arrivals, weeks in progress before Sunday 12:00, weeks older than LLM_MAX_WEEKS_BACK. thin (1–2 arrivals) has its own cases.

first_call_accept_rate.text: LLM answers accepted by check_text on the first call, over allowed cases

shown_valid_rate.text: Shown summaries (LLM if accepted, otherwise template) that pass check_text

invented_numbers.text: Shown summaries containing a number not in the facts

not_allowed_template_rate.text: Not-allowed weeks answered by the template with no LLM call

human_mean.text: Mean 1–5 rating of 10 allowed cases ('accurate and useful') by two raters who did not build the set
